query.description: Spec 화면: Device + 공정의 정의 Parameter(Chain 1 / 2) + 업로드 데이터 유무 / READY 파일 값 통계 / Fail 수 (Enable 이면 범위 밖 + '-')
query.commandtext: WITH L AS (SELECT T.*, REGEXP_SUBSTR(T.ITEM_NAME, '@([^:]+)', 1, 1, NULL, 1) AS CHAIN_NAME, REGEXP_SUBSTR(T.ITEM_NAME, '@[^:]+:(.+)$', 1, 1, NULL, 1) AS CHAIN_NAME2 FROM TQP_GDS_ET_LIMIT T WHERE T.FACTORY = :f1 AND T.DEVICE_ID = :d1 AND T.TEST_PROGRAM = :t1), I AS (SELECT ET_ITEM_SEQ, UPPER(ITEM_NAME) AS ITEM_KEY, UNIT, DISPLAY_ORDER FROM TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM WHERE FACTORY = :f2 AND DEVICE_ID = :d2), LI AS (SELECT L.ITEM_NAME, I.ET_ITEM_SEQ, I.UNIT AS ITEM_UNIT, I.DISPLAY_ORDER FROM L JOIN I ON I.ITEM_KEY = L.ITEM_NAME), X AS (SELECT ITEM_NAME, COUNT(*) AS ITEM_CNT, MIN(ITEM_UNIT) AS ITEM_UNIT, MIN(DISPLAY_ORDER) AS FIRST_ORDER FROM LI GROUP BY ITEM_NAME), V AS (SELECT LI.ITEM_NAME, V.MEAS_VALUE, V.VALUE_STATUS FROM LI JOIN TQP_GDS_ET_VALUE V ON V.ET_ITEM_SEQ = LI.ET_ITEM_SEQ JOIN TQP_GDS_SRC_FILE F ON F.SRC_FILE_SEQ = V.SRC_FILE_SEQ WHERE F.FACTORY = :f3 AND F.DEVICE_ID = :d3 AND F.TEST_PROGRAM = :t3 AND F.LOAD_STATUS = 'READY'), S AS (SELECT V.ITEM_NAME, COUNT(V.MEAS_VALUE) AS VALUE_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN V.VALUE_STATUS = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NOT_TESTED_COUNT, MIN(V.MEAS_VALUE) AS MIN_VALUE, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY V.MEAS_VALUE) AS MEDIAN_VALUE, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY V.MEAS_VALUE) AS P99_VALUE, MAX(V.MEAS_VALUE) AS MAX_VALUE, SUM(CASE WHEN L.ENABLE_FLAG = 'Y' AND (V.VALUE_STATUS = 'N' OR (V.VALUE_STATUS = 'V' AND ((L.LOWER_LIMIT IS NOT NULL AND V.MEAS_VALUE < L.LOWER_LIMIT) OR (L.UPPER_LIMIT IS NOT NULL AND V.MEAS_VALUE > L.UPPER_LIMIT)))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FAIL_COUNT FROM V JOIN L ON L.ITEM_NAME = V.ITEM_NAME GROUP BY V.ITEM_NAME) SELECT L.ITEM_NAME, L.CHAIN_NAME, L.CHAIN_NAME2, L.UNIT, X.ITEM_UNIT, CASE WHEN S.ITEM_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IN_DATA, NVL(S.VALUE_COUNT, 0) AS VALUE_COUNT, NVL(S.NOT_TESTED_COUNT, 0) AS NOT_TESTED_COUNT, S.MIN_VALUE, S.MEDIAN_VALUE, S.P99_VALUE, S.MAX_VALUE, NVL(S.FAIL_COUNT, 0) AS FAIL_COUNT, L.LOWER_LIMIT, L.UPPER_LIMIT, L.ENABLE_FLAG, L.SPEC_TEXT, L.REMARK, NVL(L.UPDATE_USER, L.CREATE_USER) AS UPDATE_USER, NVL(L.UPDATE_TIME, L.CREATE_TIME) AS UPDATE_TIME FROM L LEFT JOIN X ON X.ITEM_NAME = L.ITEM_NAME LEFT JOIN S ON S.ITEM_NAME = L.ITEM_NAME ORDER BY NVL(X.FIRST_ORDER, 999999999), L.ITEM_NAME

query.description: Setup Chain 으로 찾기: E-Test Chain 1개가 들어간 Spec(모든 공정) + Spec 없는 측정 항목 + READY 파일 값 통계 / Fail 수
query.commandtext: WITH I AS (SELECT ET_ITEM_SEQ, ITEM_NAME, UPPER(ITEM_NAME) AS ITEM_KEY, UPPER(CHAIN_NAME) AS C1, UPPER(CHAIN_NAME2) AS C2, UNIT FROM TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM WHERE FACTORY = :f1 AND DEVICE_ID = :d1 AND (UPPER(CHAIN_NAME) = :c1 OR UPPER(CHAIN_NAME2) = :c2)), L AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT T.*, REGEXP_SUBSTR(T.ITEM_NAME, '@([^:]+)', 1, 1, NULL, 1) AS C1, REGEXP_SUBSTR(T.ITEM_NAME, '@[^:]+:(.+)$', 1, 1, NULL, 1) AS C2 FROM TQP_GDS_ET_LIMIT T WHERE T.FACTORY = :f2 AND T.DEVICE_ID = :d2) WHERE C1 = :c3 OR C2 = :c4), R AS (SELECT L.TEST_PROGRAM, L.ITEM_NAME AS ITEM_KEY, L.ITEM_NAME, L.C1, L.C2, 'Y' AS DEFINED, L.LOWER_LIMIT, L.UPPER_LIMIT, L.UNIT, L.ENABLE_FLAG, L.SPEC_TEXT, L.REMARK FROM L UNION ALL SELECT NULL, I.ITEM_KEY, I.ITEM_NAME, I.C1, I.C2, 'N', NULL, NULL, I.UNIT, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM I WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM L WHERE L.ITEM_NAME = I.ITEM_KEY)), V AS (SELECT R.TEST_PROGRAM, R.ITEM_KEY, V.SRC_FILE_SEQ, V.MEAS_VALUE, V.VALUE_STATUS, CASE WHEN R.ENABLE_FLAG = 'Y' AND (V.VALUE_STATUS = 'N' OR (V.VALUE_STATUS = 'V' AND ((R.LOWER_LIMIT IS NOT NULL AND V.MEAS_VALUE < R.LOWER_LIMIT) OR (R.UPPER_LIMIT IS NOT NULL AND V.MEAS_VALUE > R.UPPER_LIMIT)))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS FAIL FROM R JOIN I ON I.ITEM_KEY = R.ITEM_KEY JOIN TQP_GDS_ET_VALUE V ON V.ET_ITEM_SEQ = I.ET_ITEM_SEQ JOIN TQP_GDS_SRC_FILE F ON F.SRC_FILE_SEQ = V.SRC_FILE_SEQ WHERE F.FACTORY = :f3 AND F.DEVICE_ID = :d3 AND F.LOAD_STATUS = 'READY' AND (R.TEST_PROGRAM IS NULL OR F.TEST_PROGRAM = R.TEST_PROGRAM)), S AS (SELECT TEST_PROGRAM, ITEM_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT SRC_FILE_SEQ) AS FILE_COUNT, COUNT(MEAS_VALUE) AS VALUE_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN VALUE_STATUS = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NOT_TESTED_COUNT, MIN(MEAS_VALUE) AS MIN_VALUE, MAX(MEAS_VALUE) AS MAX_VALUE, SUM(FAIL) AS FAIL_COUNT FROM V GROUP BY TEST_PROGRAM, ITEM_KEY) SELECT R.TEST_PROGRAM, R.ITEM_NAME, R.C1 AS CHAIN_NAME, R.C2 AS CHAIN_NAME2, R.DEFINED, R.LOWER_LIMIT, R.UPPER_LIMIT, R.UNIT, R.ENABLE_FLAG, R.SPEC_TEXT, R.REMARK, NVL(S.FILE_COUNT, 0) AS FILE_COUNT, NVL(S.VALUE_COUNT, 0) AS VALUE_COUNT, NVL(S.NOT_TESTED_COUNT, 0) AS NOT_TESTED_COUNT, S.MIN_VALUE, S.MAX_VALUE, NVL(S.FAIL_COUNT, 0) AS FAIL_COUNT FROM R LEFT JOIN S ON S.ITEM_KEY = R.ITEM_KEY AND NVL(S.TEST_PROGRAM, '~') = NVL(R.TEST_PROGRAM, '~') ORDER BY R.DEFINED DESC, R.TEST_PROGRAM, R.ITEM_KEY

query.description: Spec 화면: Device 의 공정 목록 (업로드된 파일 + Spec 이 있는 공정)
query.commandtext: SELECT TEST_PROGRAM FROM TQP_GDS_SRC_FILE WHERE FACTORY = :f1 AND DEVICE_ID = :d1 UNION SELECT TEST_PROGRAM FROM TQP_GDS_ET_LIMIT WHERE FACTORY = :f2 AND DEVICE_ID = :d2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT ITEM_NAME, LOWER_LIMIT, UPPER_LIMIT, UNIT, ENABLE_FLAG, SPEC_TEXT, REMARK FROM TQP_GDS_ET_LIMIT WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND TEST_PROGRAM = :test_program ORDER BY ITEM_NAME

query.description: Spec 저장 (있으면 수정 / 없으면 추가, InsertExecuteMultiple)
query.commandtext: MERGE INTO TQP_GDS_ET_LIMIT T USING (SELECT :factory AS FACTORY, :device_id AS DEVICE_ID, :test_program AS TEST_PROGRAM, :item_name AS ITEM_NAME, TO_BINARY_DOUBLE(:lower_limit) AS LOWER_LIMIT, TO_BINARY_DOUBLE(:upper_limit) AS UPPER_LIMIT, :unit AS UNIT, :enable_flag AS ENABLE_FLAG, :spec_text AS SPEC_TEXT, :remark AS REMARK, :update_user AS UPDATE_USER FROM DUAL) S ON (T.FACTORY = S.FACTORY AND T.DEVICE_ID = S.DEVICE_ID AND T.TEST_PROGRAM = S.TEST_PROGRAM AND T.ITEM_NAME = S.ITEM_NAME) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.LOWER_LIMIT = S.LOWER_LIMIT, T.UPPER_LIMIT = S.UPPER_LIMIT, T.UNIT = S.UNIT, T.ENABLE_FLAG = S.ENABLE_FLAG, T.SPEC_TEXT = S.SPEC_TEXT, T.REMARK = S.REMARK, T.UPDATE_USER = S.UPDATE_USER, T.UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (FACTORY, DEVICE_ID, TEST_PROGRAM, ITEM_NAME, LOWER_LIMIT, UPPER_LIMIT, UNIT, ENABLE_FLAG, SPEC_TEXT, REMARK, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) VALUES (S.FACTORY, S.DEVICE_ID, S.TEST_PROGRAM, S.ITEM_NAME, S.LOWER_LIMIT, S.UPPER_LIMIT, S.UNIT, S.ENABLE_FLAG, S.SPEC_TEXT, S.REMARK, S.UPDATE_USER, SYSDATE, S.UPDATE_USER, SYSDATE)

query.description: Spec 1행 삭제 (그 Parameter 는 판정하지 않음)
query.commandtext: DELETE FROM TQP_GDS_ET_LIMIT WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND TEST_PROGRAM = :test_program AND ITEM_NAME = :item_name
